description: As-issued history for backtests (no look-ahead): kind=daily (every source's daily hi/lo/rain per run at a place), nbm (NBM text columns: TXN, XND, P12, Q12; view=day = the books' day view), obs (settlement truth: CLI, routine-METAR max/min) or markets (what the markets tool served, each change; asof = as it stood then). from/to (<= 366 days, 1 unit per 31 days); run=ISO | lead=N (+cycle=H: the run issued N days before) | asof=ISO (what was known then). Rows carry fetched_at and origin (bf:* = backfilled). TSV by default. A successful result also carries structuredContent: the format=json body (outputSchema).

asof.description: newest run fetched by this UTC time (no look-ahead); markets: each row as it stood then

cycle.description: with lead: only runs at H UTC

fields.description: full (default) | compact: leave out null members of the JSON (structuredContent and format=json)

lead.description: the run issued N UTC days before each date

place.description: slug, name or ICAO (kind=daily, markets; nbm/obs: its station)

source.description: kind=daily: source ids, comma list (e.g. nbm,gfs,ifs)

name: history

build.description: The running commit, 7 hex (dev off Tokay). With method, ties this body's numbers to the code and rules that made them (CONTRACTS §51).

credits.description: Credit strings to keep when you repeat numbers.

method.description: Method id: the contract rules that made this body's numbers (blend-median-v1, rain-month-v5, markets-nbm-led-v4, receipts-qa-v1, history-as-issued-v3, status-readiness-v1). A rule change gives a new id, so equal ids mean the same method (CONTRACTS §51).

place.description: The place (kind=daily, markets, or a place given for nbm/obs).

rows.description: As-issued rows; every row has origin (live | bf:<tool>) and, for runs, fetched_at; markets rows have served_at (the markets run that first served the values) and build (the deployed commit).

select.description: The selection asked for (run, lead, cycle; history: asof; nbm: date).

table.description: History table (markets: what /api/v1/markets served, one row per change, CONTRACTS §43).

title: As-issued history
